pretreatment: Use of two other organic zinc precursors (diethylzinc or dimethylzinc) enabled us to lower ZnO growth temperature below 200 /C176C.
evidence: Test ZnO films were deposited on different substrates, including glass (for Hall effect electrical measurements), glass covered with ITO (for test Schottky junctions), silicon (1 0 0) (for electrical measurements and test transistor structures), silicon covered with metal (gold, aluminum, silver, for Schottky junctions) and GaAs (for optimization of growth conditions). In the VERSATILE project we concentrated on films grown on silicon, silicon covered with silver (as back contact), glass (for electrical measurements) and on sapphire substrate (for optical measurements).
